obs-studio.changelog:
33.0.1 Hotfix Changes
---------------------

* Fixed a crash on startup when logged into a service integration [WizardCM] ([#554](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/554))
* Fixed a crash when logging into the Twitch integration [WizardCM] ([#14072](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14072))
* Fixed a deadlock when logging into the YouTube integration [WizardCM] ([#556](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/556))
* Fixed a race condition where browser panels could end up with incorrectly sized content [WizardCM] ([#558](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/558))
* Fixed a memory leak when using the image slideshow source [prgmitchell] ([#14078](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14078))
* Fixed plugins failing to load on Flatpak [FiniteSingularity] ([#14103](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14103))
* Fixed Plugin Manager not prompting for save after a change until the dialog is re-opened [Warchamp7] ([#14112](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14112))

33.0 New Features
-----------------

* Updated CEF from 127/6533 to 150/7871 [WizardCM] ([#13900](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13900))
  + This is a massive update to the underlying framework used for browser sources and docks from the July 2024 release to September 2026
  + All of this work is on the backend and should be invisible to users. Please be sure to report any new weirdness or problems you run into with browser sources!
* Complete overhaul to plugin loading [FiniteSingularity/PatTheMav] ([#13594](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13594))
  + First-party plugins are now in a new folder named core
  + Third-party plugins have an updated installation location and folder structure
  + Existing third-party plugins will continue to load from the legacy locations until OBS Studio 34.0
  + More information is available in our [knowledge base article](https://obsproject.com/kb/legacy-plugin-locations)
* Improved how source snapping works in the preview [Warchamp7] ([#12298](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12298))
  + New visual indicator added
  + Sources now snap along the entire axis instead of only when directly touching
  + Sources no longer snap to hidden sources
* Improved behavior of spinboxes for number values [Warchamp7] ([#12337](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12337))
  + Typing is no longer mysteriously blocked in some situations
  + Numbers are no longer cut off in some situations
  + Values now update only after pressing Enter and Enter does not close the window
  + Holding Shift + Up/Down now advances multiple steps at a time
  + Dragging the cursor inside the input but outside the text itself now works properly
* Enabled NVENC on Arm64 [RytoEX] ([#13827](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13827))

33.0 Changes
------------

* Added a check for encoders being missing when loading a profile [derrod] ([#11340](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11340))
* Added support for newest NVIDIA Broadcast SDKs for NVIDIA Audio Effects and Video Effects [pkviet] ([#13838](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13838))
* Added hotkeys for controlling audio monitoring of a source [Warchamp7] ([#13599](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13599))
* Changed Safe Mode to not start WebSocket Server [FiniteSingularity/RytoEX] ([#13984](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13984))
* Fixed issues with groups in Studio Mode [Warchamp7] ([#11092](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11092))
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group causing them to glitch out in Program
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group showing up live in Program
* Adjusted naming of Window Capture methods on Windows [Penwy] ([#12047](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12047))
* Improved detection of fullscreen games for Game Capture [Kira-NT] ([#10880](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/10880))
* Improved transparency handling for macOS Screen Capture [jcm93] ([#13030](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13030))
* Scaled simple output recording audio bitrate by channel count [nickvonkaenel] ([#13311](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13311))
* Removed support for Ubuntu 24.04 

33.0 Bug Fixes
--------------

* Added a startup error if obs-transitions failed to load [notr1ch] ([#13321](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13321))
* Improved file splitting for Hybrid MP4/MOV [derrod] ([#13386](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13386))
* Fixed outputs getting stuck running when a bad rescale output resolution is set [suogesi] ([#13375](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13375))
* Fixed monitoring icon state getting desynced when using third-party tools or websockets [prgmitchell] ([#13822](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13822))
* Fixed a crash on macOS 27.2 when starting OBS Studio [RytoEX] ([#14070](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14070))
* Fixed potential crash when shader cache file is invalid [notr1ch] ([#13538](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13538))
* Fixed a potential crash on Linux when USB mic is removed [R0te/RytoEX] ([#13922](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13922))
* Fixed a potential crash when renaming a source with the Add Source window open [Warchamp7] ([#13800](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13800))
* Fixed a potential deadlock during video/audio tasks [exeldro] ([#13579](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13579))
* Fixed an issue with B-frame offset calculation in AMF that could cause streams to disconnect [lexano-ivs] ([#13762](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13762))
* Fixed PipeWire screencast sources being duplicated in studio mode [tytan652] ([#13673](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13673))

keepassxc.changelog:
### New Features
- Add remote database synchronization and import using external tools [#7222, #10896, #11271]
- Allow configuring keyboard shortcuts [#9643]
- SSH Agent: Add support for generating RSA, ECDSA, and Ed25519 keys [#7215]
- Linux: Add Wayland Auto-Type support using XDG Desktop Portals [#13359, #13449, #13579, #13770, #13810]
- Linux: Add Quick Unlock using Polkit (adds a UUID to public metadata, marking database as modified on first launch) [#8983]
- Linux Add AArch64 AppImage [#13816]
- macOS: Allow Quick Unlock using the device password when Touch ID is unavailable [#11410]
- Windows: Allow administrators to enforce certain user settings via global Group Policy overrides [#11223]
- Windows: Add native Arm64 builds [#13678, #13727]

### Major Changes
- Migrate to Qt 6 [#11651, #7783, #13456, #13473, #13684, #13784]
- Linux: Store application state in XDG_STATE_HOME instead of XDG_CACHE_HOME [#9755]
- Build: Bundle build features under a single KPXC_MINIMAL CMake option [#11003]

### Security Fixes
- Fix use-after-free when importing crafted KDB files (CVE-2026-69150; Credits: A. Ramos (@aramosf)) [#13500]
- Browser: Prevent entry reference injection when creating or updating entries via browser extension (CVE-PENDING; Credits: Davonte (@BadPingHere)) [#13580, #13670, #13688]
- Browser: Fix out-of-bounds writes when encrypting and decrypting native messaging messages (CVE-2026-118673; Credits: @sigure21) [#13679]
- Windows: Randomize shared memory mapping names when sending SSH keys to Pageant (CVE-PENDING; Credits: NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), Viktor Markopoulos NCIA/NCSC) [#13680]
- Fix integer overflow and out-of-bounds read in legacy KDB importer (CVE-PENDING; Credits: NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), Viktor Markopoulos NCIA/NCSC) [#13682]
- Secret Service: Exclude protected attributes from attribute listings (Credits: Koda Reef (@kodareef5)) [#13674]
- Windows: Fix clipboard exclusion format name (Credits: @ByeWhiteLists) [#13352]
- Improve clearing of decrypted database fragments from memory used by zlib [#13677]

### Changes
- Change Clone Entry shortcut to Ctrl+D [#10903]
- Show suggestions when adding or renaming additional attributes [#13633]
- Add passkey and TOTP entry counts to database statistics in GUI and CLI [#13632]
- Remove legacy KeePassHTTP attribute conversion [#8007]
- Browser: Support get-database-entries request to list entry titles, URLs, and UUIDs [#7292]
- CLI: Reduce GUI library dependencies and simplify line reader code [#9701, #13330]
- Proton Pass Importer: Support Wi-Fi, SSH keys, and unknown entry types [#13148]
- Update translations and clean up code [#9702, #12611, #13258, #8008, #7999, #7998]

### Fixes
- Fix application lockups on systems with one or two CPU cores [#13296]
- Preserve entry custom data in newly created history items [#13573]
- Fix password strength evaluation for referenced passwords [#13479]
- Respect password generator settings when auto-generating passwords for new entries [#13277]
- Fix case-sensitive search with the + prefix modifier [#13493]
- Fix directory creation error handling [#13508]
- Fix favicon download redirect limit being ignored [#13663]
- Fix showing challenge-response credentials without a password [#13615]
- Fix key file selection link not being clickable when translated incorrectly [#13396]
- Prevent database unlock controls from shrinking vertically [#13428]
- Prevent mouse wheel scrolling from changing the unfocused alternative save method setting [#13358]
- Fix password font size not following application font size [#13658]
- Fix typos and documentation links [#10124, #10893, #9993]
- Fix null pointer dereference in Secret Service integration [#13655]
- Fix ellipsis password reuse tooltip in database reports [#13091]
- Fix database lock after autosave due to external changes [#13733]
- Auto-Type: Support {PGDN} placeholder [#13463]
- Auto-Type: Refactor Auto-Type plugins to integrate them into the main binary [#13469]
- Browser: Fix showing and closing the password generator [#9984, #9743]
- Browser: Respect selected database when storing a new passkey [#13798]
- CSV Import: Fix automatic column mapping for English headers with non-English UI languages [#13531]
- Secret Service: Fix crash when a database locks while the item access dialog is open [#13598, #13602]
- SSH Agent: Prevent recursive updates when changing entry settings and attachments [#13068]
- Linux: Improve AppImage desktop integration [#13470, #13476]
- Linux: Include keyutils in Snap builds [#10687]
- Linux: Fix race condition in dark mode detection at startup [#13366]
- Linux: Do not query X root window without a display with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen [#13761]
- Linux: Improve TLS handling im AppImages [#13805]
- macOS: Improve window tray hide and restore behaviour [#13645]
- macOS: Use the native temporary directory for the browser integration socket [#13484]
- macOS: Prevent deleting entries and groups while a modal dialog is open [#13383]
- macOS: Prevent hiding the menu bar [#13147]
- macOS: Fix application icon installation for IDE builds [#12679]
- Windows: Fix SSH Agent builds with MSYS2 [#8708]
- Build: Fix build-system-related issues [#13278, #13275]

localsend.changelog:
This release fixes compatibility issues with 1.17.0 and earlier.
Note: The Windows binaries have been updated to include a signature.

- feat(desktop): allow customizing the web share pages by placing HTML files in a `web` folder next to the executable
- feat(cli): add version info to the Windows executable
- feat(linux): set actual version in the AppImage
- security: do not follow HTTP redirects sent by peers
- fix: restore compatibility with 1.17.0 and earlier versions on missing multicast networks
- fix: devices running 1.17.0 and earlier could not add 1.18.0+ device as favorite
- fix: ignore proxies, fixes "TLS info not found" when a system proxy (e.g. Shadowrocket) is enabled
- fix: automatically restart the HTTP / multicast server when it dies or when the app resumes
- fix: drag and drop with a mix of folders and files
- fix: during transfer, add bottom padding when Advanced is open (@Chethan616)
- fix: do not crash at startup when the executable path cannot be resolved (@Shlomo116)
- fix(android): ignore unknown or invalid file modification times when reading files
- i18n: add Armenian

flow-launcher.changelog:
# Release notes

## Bug fixes

- Fixed Firefox bookmark loading when profiles.ini uses different line endings.

- Reduced error log noise by treating missing shortcut descriptions as debug messages instead of errors.

- History results now appear on startup when the “Show History Results in Home Page” option is enabled, even if the home page is turned off.

- Context menus on the home page now open with the right arrow and show up-to-date options.

- Flow will now take keyboard focus on Windows startup (when not hidden), so you can type in the search box right away.

- Fixed an issue that could leave outdated data in settings or other stored files when saving a new version with shorter JSON content.

- Improved shell command handling for quoted paths and multi-word arguments. Command history now properly preserves your original input.

- Quoted commands now run correctly in the Windows CMD shell, and command launching via Windows Terminal is more reliable.

- Improved URL support for browser, file, about:, and data: links. Removed insecure ftp:// support.

- Improved URL matching for local and private IP addresses, including IPv6 support.

- Updated translations

- More reliable full screen detection on Windows with reduced chance of crashes.

- Fixed a bug that could set the app to the wrong language on startup.

- Search via acronyms has been fixed to properly work with results that contain numbers.

## Contributions
We would like to directly mention and thank the following people (in alphabetical order) for their contribution and support in this release.

@DavidGBrett, @dedonnodev, @Jack251970, @SparkUiX, @taooceros, @VictoriousRaptor and everyone who has joined discussions, added translations, created plugins, reviewed pull requests, put through their ideas or reported bugs.

A big thank you to @JakobOstgren for sponsoring us! ❤️

peazip.changelog: PeaZip 11.4.0 continues the effort to strengthen security, with improved validation of input, extensive use of range check, removal of use of console for backend tasks. Usability is also improved with enhanced auto-refresh for file browser, and ability to browse .lnk files destination dirs on Windows (Ctrl+P). Backend are updated with Pea 1.34 and 7z/p7zip 26.04. Sources are compiled with Lazarus 4.x, and are still compatible with Lazarus 3.x and 2.x. A total of 243 file extensions are now supported as archives by PeaZip.

handbrake.changelog:
## Upgrade Notice

Before updating HandBrake, please make sure there are no pending encodes in the queue, and be sure to make a backup of any custom presets and app preferences you have, as they may not be compatible with newer versions.

Windows users, please make sure to install [Microsoft .NET Desktop Runtime version 10.0](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0/runtime)
Download available from Microsoft:
- [For x64 (AMD or Intel CPUs)](https://aka.ms/dotnet/10.0/windowsdesktop-runtime-win-x64.exe)
- [For Arm64 (Qualcomm or other)](https://aka.ms/dotnet/10.0/windowsdesktop-runtime-win-arm64.exe)


## HandBrake 1.11.2

### All platforms

#### Video

- Fixed a crash that happened when doing a 2-pass lossless x265 encode
- Fixed a memory leak that happened when doing a 2-pass MPEG-4/MPEG-2/VP9/FFV1 encode

#### Audio

- Updated the list of supported dithers and encoders combinations
- Fixed the Core Audio AAC encoder 7.1 channel layout

#### Subtitles

- Fixed the VobSub palette creation in the MP4 container

#### Build system

- Improved build system compatibility with older build tools

#### Third-party libraries

- Updated libraries
  - FFmpeg 8.0.2 (decoding and filters)
  - SVT-AV1 4.1.0 (AV1 video encoding)

### Linux

- Added WebM MIME type to the list of the supported formats

### Mac

- Improved handling of unsupported presets
- Updated Sparkle automatic update library

### Windows

- Improved handling of unsupported presets
- Improved queue low space pause behaviour
- Fixed the automatic audio track name generation
- Fixed the summary description of HDR video

shotcut.changelog:
## What's Changed

See a  [nicely formatted page](https://www.shotcut.org/blog/new-release-26.9.27/) on the web site.

- Fixed security flaws in upgrade and Whisper downloads (failed HTTPS was retried over HTTP, certificate errors could be ignored, and a downloaded file could be used without a trusted digest).
- Fixed **Mask: Draw (Glaxnimate)** filter, **Operation > Subtract** for 8-bit processing mode (broke in version 25.12).
- Fixed using **Size, Position & Rotate** with **Mask: Apply** filters (broke in version 25.12).
- Improved audio quality by removing a conversion to 16-bit integer and keeping the pipeline in 32-bit float.
- Fixed LV2 external audio plugins not loading on Windows (unless `LV2_PATH` environment var set explicitly).
- Fixed VA-API HEVC hardware encoder on Linux.
- Fixed **Show in Folder** not working with non-ASCII characters on Linux.
- Fixed **Import Subtitles from File** not working on Windows.
- Fixed **Subtitles** view shows incorrect duration (broke in version 26.8).
- Fixed moving **Timeline** clip next to another with snap while zoomed out may insert 1 blank frame.
- Fixed copy and pasting a **Timeline** transition corrupt audio in the pasted transition.
- Fixed window title bar missing on Linux with **Settings > Display Method > Vulkan**.
- Fixed marker unexpectedly deleted when moving a clip to the left with **Ripple Markers** on.
- Fixed keyframes on **Timeline > Split** after a transition.
- Fixed **Export** job may report failure even though file was completed successfully.
- Fixed some buffer overflow security issues in PGM/wipe reading in MLT and **Set Equirectangular** in Shotcut.
- Fixed projects deleted from disk still appear in **Projects**.
- Fixed `Ctrl+Up` and `Ctrl+Down` cannot change current track when **Timeline** loses focus.
- Fixed **Player > External Monitor > DeckLink** (and related such as UltraStudio) HDMI/SDI may deadlock. 
- Fixed MLT XML nested clip's length (duration) not updated, now updates when selected but needs manual trim to increase clip.
- Fixed redundant context menu on text edit controls in filters on Windows (broke in v26.8).
- Fixed open project on a mounted CIFS/SMB share on Linux kernel 7.1 and above.
- Fixed possible crash when trying to add subtitle item in the last half second of the timeline.
- Hardened MP4 parsing in **Set Equirectangular** in **Properties** and export job context menu.
- Changed **Settings > Leave Safe Mode** to an always-present **Allow External Plugins** checkbox that defaults to off.
  This helps prevent the problem that some VST2 plugins on Windows and macOS are causing startup and shutdown (including export) problems.
- Detect a stuck application startup to automatically disable external plugins.
- Added **Automatic Audio Ducking** for audio to timeline track **Properties**.
- Changed **Adjust Clip Gain** for timeline clips to require `Ctrl+Alt` (`option+command` on macOS) to drag.
  This makes it safe from inadvertent changes while selecting and dragging clips. So, now that setting
  defaults on again. Also, a tooltip was added to the clip's audio line. 
- Added volume control and audio level meter/indicator to **Timeline** track headers.
  This effectively makes the track header column a mixing console without needing to clutter the UI with a new panel.
  The gain filter this adds to the track is keyframable.
- Added **Timeline > Generate > Adjustment Clip**. This is a dummy video clip that contributes no video.
  Instead, its filters apply to the composite of all video tracks below it.
- Added `application.triggerAction(name)`, `multitrack.clipStart()`, and `timeline.split()` functions for scripts.
- Added a context menu with **Copy** to **Missing Files** dialog and **View > Resources**.
- Improved the performance of the **Timeline**: moving clips to another track, zooming, undo for many operations (except for ripple move/trim).
- Improved the appearance of the user interface to be more modern with rounded corners in many places.
- New logo
- Upgraded FFmpeg to version 9.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mltframework/shotcut/compare/v26.8.1...v26.9.27

trafficmonitor.changelog:
**功能新增**
* 新增任务栏窗口显示在副显示器的功能。#2037 #1974  #1952 #1944 #1875 #1870 #1863 #1734
* 多语言代码重构，多语言字符串在外部ini文件中配置，方便程序本地化。新增德语、意大利语、俄语、波兰语、巴西葡萄牙语、土耳其语、希伯来语等语言的支持。
* 更换皮肤界面皮肤列表控件改为ListBox。
* 选项设置对话框中的控件支持动态调整大小。
* 选项设置对话框调整大小时，垂直滚动条不再复位。
* 任务栏窗口显示项目宽度支持动态调整。
* 新增任务栏资源占用图背景颜色跟随Windows主题颜色的功能。
* 新增每个皮肤的字体、文本颜色、显示文本单独保存的功能。
* 显示文本设置对话框中增加右键菜单，允许为单独的项目恢复默认。
* 崩溃信息窗口新增调用堆栈的显示，新增将崩溃信息写入日志的功能。
* Lite版新增了显卡和硬盘利用率显示。

**问题修正**
* 修正“常规设置”中更新源没有保存的问题 #2020 #1561 #1119
* 修正多显示器DPI不一致时更换皮肤对话框预览图中字体大小不正确的问题。
* 修正当悬浮窗在不同DPI的显示器间移动时DPI可能不正确的问题
* 修正显示了插件项目时任务栏内置项目不能全部去掉，会保留一个上传速度的问题 #1965
* 优化了选项设置中“颜色显示”控件中颜色显示的样式，修正颜色数量大于8个时控件右侧有明显的空白的问题
* 修正主窗口和任务栏窗口设置中，更改“字体大小”文本框中的值后点击“应用”没有生效的问题
* 修正任务栏窗口鼠标提示中的网速单位和设置的不一致的问题
* 修正CPU频率不遵循“数值和单位用空格分隔”选项的问题
* 添加从睡眠状态恢复时重新初始化连接的处理，解决有时从睡眠状态恢复时无法获取到网速的问题。
* 修正皮肤文件中字体名称有Unicode字符时无法获取正确的字体的问题，并修正了皮肤文件解析的一些逻辑问题。
* 其他细节方面的改进。

**New Features**  
- Added the feature to display the taskbar window on secondary monitors. #2037 #1974 #1952 #1944 #1875 #1870 #1863 #1734  
- Refactored multilingual code; multilingual strings are now configured in external INI files for easier localization. Added support for new languages such as German, Italian, Russian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Hebrew.  
- Replaced the skin list control in the skin selection interface with a ListBox.  
- Controls in the Options Settings dialog now support dynamic resizing.
- The vertical scrollbar in the Options Settings dialog no longer resets when resizing.  
- The width of items in the taskbar window now supports dynamic adjustment.  
- Added the feature for the taskbar resource usage graph background color to follow the Windows theme color.  
- Added the ability to save fonts, text colors, and display text separately for each skin.  
- Added a right-click menu in the Display Text Settings dialog to restore defaults for individual items.  
- Added the display of call stack in crash information dialog. Add the function of writing the crash information to the log file.
- Added the display of GPU and hard disk utilization for the Lite version.

**Bug Fixes**  
- Fixed the issue where the update source in "General Settings" was not saved. #2020 #1561 #1119  
- Fixed incorrect font size in the preview image of the skin selection dialog when DPI settings differ across multiple monitors.  
- Fixed incorrect DPI when the floating window moves between monitors with different DPI settings.  
- Fixed the issue where built-in items in the taskbar could not be fully removed when plugin items were displayed, leaving an upload speed item. #1965  
- Optimized the style of color display in the "Color Display" control in the Options Settings dialog. Fixed the issue where noticeable blank space appeared on the right side of the control when more than 8 colors were displayed.  
- Fixed the issue where changing the value in the "Font Size" text box in the main window and taskbar window settings did not take effect after clicking "Apply."  
- Fixed the inconsistency between the network speed unit in the taskbar window tooltip and the settings.  
- Fixed the issue where CPU frequency did not follow the "Separate value and unit with a space" option.  
- Added handling to reinitialize connections after resuming from sleep mode, resolving the issue where network speed could not be retrieved after waking from sleep.
- Fixed the issue that the correct font could not be obtained when font name in the skin file contains Unicode characters. Fixed some logical problems when parsing the skin file.
- Improved in other details.

windows-terminal.changelog:
With this release, Terminal 1.25 is being rolled out to General Availability; see [the prior version](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/releases/tag/v1.25.2733.0) for overall release notes.

## Changes

* (1.26 backport) conhost: we now always use the "cls" detector to prevent screen clearing from committing the entire (virtualized) text buffer (#19957)

## Bug Fixes
 
### Accessibility
 
* The "delete" confirmation flyouts will no longer be truncated on higher Text Scaling settings (#20868)
 
### Terminal Emulation

* The Kitty Keyboard Protocol mode will now be maintained properly across main/alternate screen buffer switches (#20768)
* `LNM` line feed mode will no longer be mishandled when it is toggled before and after a newline in the same packet (#20863)
* Applications can no longer set window titles longer than 1000 characters (like xterm) (#20839)
* Applications which scroll the screen buffer will once again be translated properly (such as `vi` from 1996) (#20774)
* Clicking on a URL while an application is reading mouse reports will no longer generate a spurious mouse release event (#20756) (thanks @OmarMashal0!) (edit: er, I (@DHowett) cannot confirm that this is actually fixed)
* Injected keyboard input will no longer come out with unexpected vkey values such as `0xFFFF` (#20800) (thanks @shrikargs7-cloud!)
* Terminal once again sends the `ENHANCED_KEY` state to console applications for Alt and F7 (#20619) (thanks @TheJesper!)
 
### Others

* `useAcrylicInTabRow` users rejoice! We've fixed one of the major sources of flickering in the title bar (#20881)
* `file:` URIs containing Unicode characters will no longer send us into a wild tailspin (#20809)
* Terminal will no longer load up a US keyboard on you (whoops) (#20769)
* Writing a non-numeric value in the command history pop-up will no longer act unexpectedly (#20779)

---

_Binary files inside the unpackaged distribution archive bear the version number `1.25.261109001`._

motrix.changelog:
# Motrix 2.4.1

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/main/docs/release-notes/2.4.1.zh-CN.md)

## Changes since 2.4.0

- Bundle **aria2 1.37.0-motrix.24**. On Windows, the engine tries the remaining resolved addresses for a host after a connection fails. It reports a network error if all candidates fail. Existing DNS and IPv6 defaults are preserved.
- Upgrade to **i18next 27.0.1** and **react-i18next 18.0.1**. The desktop app, Web UI and Server CLI continue to fall back to `en-US` for missing translations.
- Refresh the form validation, IP database, proxy and WebSocket dependencies, along with the Vite build tools and the jsdom test environment.

## Upgrade compatibility

**Back up your profile and download files before upgrading.** The bundled engine
uses SQLite **schema 6**. When upgrading an older engine database, retain its
complete pre-upgrade backup; older engines cannot open schema 6. Stop all engines
before restoring a verified backup to a separate path for a downgrade. Do not
reset or delete the upgraded database as a substitute for recovery.

Users migrating from Motrix v1 should follow the
[migration guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.4.1/docs/legacy-migration.md)
and retain the original profile and engine database backups.

## Downloads and updates

Desktop packages support macOS 13 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux, with
native x64 and ARM64 builds. No 32-bit desktop packages are provided. Official
macOS packages require signing and notarization. Windows NSIS installers and ZIP
archives are unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen; use official Release downloads.

Stable publication updates both `latest*.yml` and `beta*.yml` feeds to 2.4.1.
Flatpak bundles and Native Host companions remain separate downloads. Snap
availability requires verified Store publication to edge and promotion of the
same amd64/arm64 revisions through candidate to stable.

Server images use `docker.io/motrixapp/motrix-server:2.4.1` and
`ghcr.io/agalwood/motrix-server:2.4.1`. After public multi-platform runtime
verification, `2.4`, `2`, `stable`, and `latest` advance to the same verified digest.
See the [Docker Server guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.4.1/docs/docker-server.md).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.4.0...v2.4.1)

* fix(engine): bundle aria2 with windows connect failover by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2515
* chore(release): upgrade translation dependencies and prepare 2.4.1 by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2516


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.4.0...v2.4.1

- [Steam Link device](https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-qt/releases/download/v6.2.0/Moonlight-SteamLink-6.2.0.zip)

The Windows installer package may require an Internet connection to download the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime if your PC does not already have it installed. If you do not have Internet access during installation, you can pre-install the runtime from [Microsoft's website](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/the-latest-supported-visual-c-downloads-2647da03-1eea-4433-9aff-95f26a218cc0) or use the portable version.

To update an existing installation, simply run the latest installer (for Windows) or replace the old app in your Applications folder (for Mac). For the portable Windows version, extract the ZIP into a new folder and copy the `Moonlight Game Streaming Project` folder from the older version to preserve your settings and paired hosts.

**Important note for Windows Portable upgrades from v6.1.0 or earlier:** If you extracted the portable Windows v6.2.0 ZIP file into the same folder as an earlier version of Moonlight, you must delete `qopensslbackend.dll` file in the `tls` folder or Moonlight will crash on startup.

To install on Steam Link hardware, extract the ZIP file to the root of a FAT32 flash drive, insert it into your Steam Link, then restart the Steam Link. Moonlight can run alongside official Steam Link streaming and other Steam Link apps.

**Behavior changes:**
- The default renderer on macOS is now libplacebo (using MoltenVK). You can change renderers on macOS in the Advanced Settings.
- Most video renderers now use full range color instead of limited range
- The cursor is now also locked to the video area in single display borderless windowed scenarios. This was previously only done in true full-screen mode.
- The cursor is no longer captured by default in windowed mode. Clicking on the streaming window or pressing Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z will capture the cursor.
- Game Mode has been re-enabled on macOS
- The Metal renderer is supported on Macs with a discrete GPU. It was previously only available on Macs with an iGPU.
- HDR metadata is now used for tonemapping on macOS. You may need to tweak your HDR brightness in the OS, particularly for external non-Apple displays.
- CLI output is now displayed in the console on Windows instead of a dialog box
- GPUs on non-x86 Linux platforms are now assumed to be slow by default, which enables a number of optimizations for improved performance. GL_IS_SLOW=0/VULKAN_IS_SLOW=0 can be set at runtime to override this.
- Gamepad motion sensors are disabled on Steam Link hardware to help reduce audio glitching caused by high CPU usage. The moonlight.sh script can be edited to re-enable them.
- The default streaming resolution for new installs is now 1080p instead of 720p.
- Video bitrate no longer resets when adjusting resolution or frame rate if it's already been manually adjusted

**Security:**
- CVE-2026-33546, CVE-2026-33547, and CVE-2026-41210 have been fixed
- These vulnerabilities could allow a malicious host to crash Moonlight when connecting

**New Features:**
- Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K has been added to toggle system keyboard grab
- D3D11 renderer has been updated to enable VRR support on Nvidia GPUs and improve performance by reducing VRAM copies and allowing overlapping decoding and rendering operations
- KMSDRM renderer is rewritten to support atomic modesetting, overlays, VRR, ALLM, software decoding, V-sync off with atomic async flip, and more
- Vulkan rendering is now supported on Linux outside of a desktop environment (KMSDRM)
- AV1 hardware decoding is now supported on macOS (M3 and later)
- AppImages now support using the system libva to prevent hardware decoding failure on distros with newer libva versions
- Added support for DualSense adaptive triggers (requires a compatible host)
- Gamepads with a second trackpad can now be passed to the host (requires host support)
- Client identifiers are now provided to the host to allow client-specific session management
- Added an option to disable pre-launch warnings
- YUV 4:4:4 video is now supported by the DXVA2 renderer
- Raspberry Pi 2 and 3 are now officially supported (in addition to Pi 4 and 5 models, which were already supported). 1080p 60 FPS requires overclocking (gpu_freq_min=400) on the Pi 2.

**Bugfixes:**
- Reduced background CPU usage
- Improved startup, settings pa

Note: Read [NanaZip Technical Focus from Kenji Mouri](https://github.com/M2Team/NanaZip/issues/913) to clarify some future directions of NanaZip.

Starting with NanaZip 7.0, NanaZip follows a rolling release model. Read https://github.com/M2Team/NanaZip/blob/main/Documents/Versioning.md#release-tags for more information.

We recommend holding off on File Manager-related pull requests for now, as they may require a complete rewrite afterward. Such contributions may become practical again around mid-November or December.

mpc-hc.changelog:
[Donations](https://github.com/clsid2/mpc-hc/issues/383) are appreciated. There is now a PayPal option.

### Changes from 2.8.4 to 2.8.5:

Updates:
* Updated LAV Filters to version 0.83-20-gd8d8a
* Updated MPC Video Renderer to version 0.11.2.2638

Changes/additions:
* Significant performance improvements in internal subtitle renderer for rendering complex subtitles
* Added an option to draw rounded corners when using an opaque box for default subtitle style
* Added hotkey entry for opening "Show history" dialog

Fixes:
* Lots of small fixes and improvements

### Full changelog

Full list of **[all changes](https://github.com/clsid2/mpc-hc/issues/4014)** since start of this project.

### Overview of features

A lot of people seem to be unaware of some of the awesome features that have been added to MPC-HC in the past years. Here is a list of useful options and features that everyone should know about:
<details><summary><ins>Click to expand</ins></summary>

* Play HDR video
This requires using either MPC Video Renderer (MPCVR) or [madVR](http://forum.doom9.org/showthread.php?t=146228).
These renderers can be selected here:
Options > Playback > Output
With other video renderers, the colors will be wrong!
MPCVR is included and is the recommended and default renderer for modern systems. MadVR needs to be installed separately. MPCVR also supports Dolby Vision. MadVR does not.
For optimal performance you should change the hardware decoder to D3D11 in LAV Video Decoder settings when using MPCVR on Windows 10/11, because this renderer uses DirectX11.
* The installer of MPC-HC is very basic (and that will not change).
I therefore recommend using [K-Lite Codec Pack](http://codecguide.com/download_kl.htm). That includes MPC-HC and other essential components. It has a very advanced installation that can automatically create file associations, and helps you with easy configuration of important MPC-HC settings, such as preferred subtitle language(s). It also does automatic configuration of renderer and hardware decoding, for best performance and HDR support.
The Standard version should be sufficient for most people. Use Full version of you like to use MadVR.
* Modern GUI Theme (Dark or Light) or the old classic theme
Options > Player > User Interface
It is also possible to change the height of the seekbar and size of the toolbar buttons.
Plus there are options to show audio/video details in the statusbar, such as codec and resolution.
* Customizable toolbar buttons
You can add/remove/re-order the player buttons.
There are also several different toolbar designs to choose from.
* Video preview on the seekbar
Options > Player > User Interface > Hover type
* Ability to search for subtitles
Press D for manual search.
Or enable automatic search in: Options > Subtitles > Misc 
* Adjust playback speed
Menu > Play > Playback rate
The buttons in the player that control playback rate take a 2x step by default. This can be customized to smaller values (like 10%):
Options > Playback > Speed step
If you have 1000 IQ you can even do smart stuff like setting playback rate change to mouse right-click + scrollwheel:
Options > Player > Mouse
Adjusting playback speed works best with MPC Audio Renderer or SaneAR. These audio renderers have automatic pitch correction, while DirectSound does not.
Options > Playback > Output > Audio Renderer
* MPC-HC can remember recently played files and also their playback position, so you can resume playback from when you left
Options > Player > History
* You can quickly seek through a video with Ctrl + Mouse Scrollwheel.
* You can jump to next/previous file in a folder by pressing PageUp/PageDown.
* You can right-click on the framestep button to step backwards. Some other buttons also have right-click actions, such as closing file by right-clicking stop.
* You can perform automatic actions at end of file. For example to go to next file or close player.
Options > Playback > After Playback (permanent setting)
Menu > Play > After Playback (for current file only)
* A-B repeat
You can loop a segment of a video. Press [ and ] to set start and stop markers.
* You can rotate/flip/mirror/stretch/zoom the video
Menu > View > Pan&Scan
This is also easily done with hotkeys (see below).
* There are lots of keyboard hotkeys and mouse actions to control the player. They can be customized as well.
Options > Player > Keys
Tip: there is a search box above the table.
* You can hide GUI elements even in windowed mode
Options > User Interface > Hide Windowed Controls
That hides most GUI elements during playback. To show them simply move your mouse to bottom of window.
You can even hide everything except the video by pressing `1` (restore normal view with `3`). 
* You can seek inside the playlist by simply typing text (when playlist window has the mouse focus).
* MPC-HC also supports Blu-ray playback.
Only limitation is that you need to use a decrypting tool.
And it also does not support Blu-ray menus, but you can use the navigate menu in the player to select the content to play.
* Added ability to load a secondary subtitle file to view two different subtitle tracks/languages at same time.
* You can stream videos directly from Youtube and many other video websites
Put [yt-dlp.exe](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases) in the MPC-HC installation folder.
Then you can open website URLs in the player: Menu > File > Open File/URL
You can even download those videos: Menu > File > Save a copy
Tip: to be able to download in best quality with yt-dlp, it is recommended to also put [ffmpeg.exe](https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/) in the MPC-HC folder.
Several YDL configuration options are found here: Options > Advanced
This includes an option to specify the location of yt-dlp.exe in case you don't want to put it in MPC-HC folder.
Note 1: You also need to install [Microsoft Visual C++ 2010 SP1 Redistributable Package (x86)](https

paint-net.changelog:
These are the offline installers, portable ZIPs, and deployment MSIs for Paint.NET. The web installer is also provided, which will download and run the correct installer for any supported CPU and OS.

**Release notes:** https://forums.paint.net/topic/134628-paintnet-52-is-now-available

**System Requirements**
- Windows 11, or Windows 10 v21H2, or Windows Server 2022
- 64-bit CPU (Intel/AMD x64 with AVX2, or ARM64) with at least 4 cores
- GPU with support for Direct3D 11
- SSD
- _Optional:_ A display that supports High Dynamic Range (HDR) or Wide Color Gamut (WCG)
- _Optional:_ A pen or drawing tablet that supports Windows Ink

**Experimental**
- Wine🍷 support (e.g. Linux and Mac) is available in a separate package at https://github.com/paintdotnet/Paint.NET-on-WINE

**Notes about supported hardware:**
- Examples of CPUs with AVX2 include:
  - Intel Core 4th generation (Haswell, 2013) or newer
  - AMD Ryzen 1st generation (2017) or newer.
- For HDR and WCG displays, Paint.NET will be able to make use of the display's full color gamut and Windows will manage color accuracy and consistency. Images will not be clamped to sRGB's color gamut.
- For SDR displays, Paint.NET will operate in sRGB mode which means images will be clamped to sRGB's color gamut. This ensures consistent color reproduction, but color accuracy depends on the display itself being configured for sRGB as well.

**Notes about unsupported hardware:**
- Intel/AMD CPUs without AVX2 will still work but will be slower. Our testing and optimization efforts no longer include Intel/AMD CPUs without AVX2. **_However_, if your CPU does not support SSE4.2 then the app will not work at all.**
- CPUs with less than 4 cores should still work but will be slower.
- An HDD will work but will have slow performance and it is not supported. Our testing and optimization efforts no longer include HDDs.
- GPUs that do not support Direct3D 11 cannot be used, relegating those tasks to the CPU. Performance will be slower, and some effects may take an excruciatingly long time to render.

_(Friendly hint: If you don't know what an MSI is, then it's almost certainly not the download you want. Just grab the "anycpu" installer if you're not sure which one to use.)_

_The "source code" ZIP does not contain any actual files or source code, it is just included automatically as part of GitHub's "releases" functionality._

logseq.changelog:
Logseq 2.0.2 Beta brings smoother editing, faster startup, and more reliable everyday workflows to the DB version.

[Join the iOS TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/eBcJ9Hpc), 2.0.2 is currently under App Store review.

Web app: https://app.logseq.com/

## Features

- Gallery cards can now use URL properties as covers.
- Added a "Clear heading" slash command.
- Improved video embeds, with resizable desktop players and clickable YouTube timestamps.

## Thanks

- **Special thanks to our community PR contributors!** Your fixes, performance improvements, translations, and careful reviews helped make this beta better. Contributors include [@yuxi-liu-wired](https://github.com/yuxi-liu-wired), [@ChipNowacek](https://github.com/ChipNowacek), [@Mancn-Xu](https://github.com/Mancn-Xu), [@hahaArthur17](https://github.com/hahaArthur17), [@maksym-dilanian](https://github.com/maksym-dilanian), [@qwist1233-cpu](https://github.com/qwist1233-cpu), and many others.
- **A heartfelt thank-you to everyone testing the DB beta.** Your bug reports, reproduction steps, feedback, and retesting of fixes have been invaluable. Thank you for helping us improve Logseq with your real-world graphs and workflows!

## Fixed issues

Ordered by impact on data integrity, reliability, and everyday workflows.

1. **Preserve unsaved edits:** Save pending text before following page or block references, switching blocks, or setting Deadline/Scheduled. Pasting multiple blocks no longer lets a stale editor buffer erase the first pasted title.
2. **Restore deleted content with undo/redo:** Restore deleted blocks and pages that reference each other, along with property schemas and values. Undoing block moves now preserves their original order and nested structure.
3. **Keep block trees intact when copying or moving:** Selecting an ancestor together with its descendants no longer pulls grandchildren out of their subtree. Copy/paste preserves the original child blocks, and embed actions operate on the embed rather than its source.
4. **Keep graph and asset downloads running:** One failed asset download no longer stops the remaining asset queue or fails the graph download. Sync also keeps property-value replacements together instead of splitting them across requests.
5. **Fix Windows installation:** Fix the NSIS installer crash affecting Windows 11 24H2 and newer, so the desktop app can be installed normally.
6. **Improve file-to-DB import fidelity:** Preserve headings, icons, journal timestamps, and PDF annotation identities/order. Asset links in property values are converted into asset references, and same-title classes and properties remain distinct.
7. **Correct scheduled dates and repeating tasks:** Deadline/Scheduled repeats now advance in the local calendar. Monthly repeats no longer drift permanently after a shorter month; date filters use local days, and clearing dates removes stale journal references.
8. **Prevent query errors from crashing the graph:** Incomplete query syntax, invalid regular expressions, and query-function rendering errors are isolated. Query-builder filters again show property/tag names and include custom Status and Priority choices.
9. **Fix property editing and choice selection:** Selected node values remain visible in property pickers, choice identities resolve consistently, and configuration toggles save the newly selected value. Empty multi-value slots and date values can be cleared without errors.
10. **Restore readable search results and references:** Resolve UUID references in search titles, breadcrumbs, and nested page references. References to deleted nodes remain visible as broken links, and opening search no longer clears its results.
11. **Restore settings and HTML publishing:** Settings can be saved when config.edn is missing or invalid, and the first export.css edit creates the file correctly. HTML exports no longer open as a blank page and honor the configured home page.
12. **Make desktop editing and keyboard input reliable:** Clicks during scrolling now open the editor. A click after Escape or Shift+Up/Down keeps the newly opened editor, and fixes cover international dead-key input and IME confirmation in search.
13. **Fix Android popup and layout issues:** Nested popups reuse the presented native sheet, sheet dismissal avoids re-entry, and the layout respects the status-bar safe area. Mobile cloud-graph download and sync triggers work again.

## Enhancements

- **Faster startup and smoother editing:** Improved desktop startup, journal loading, large-page rendering, table scrolling, and search, with fewer unnecessary updates while typing.
- **Better everyday workflows:** Improved flashcard practice, date and repeating-task handling, international keyboard input, plugin APIs, CLI behavior, and translations.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/compare/2.0.1...2.0.2)

git.changelog:
Changes since Git for Windows v2.56.0(4) (October 26th 2026)

This addresses the security issues CVE-2026-111760, CVE-2026-113408, CVE-2026-114466, CVE-2026-114467, CVE-2026-114469 and CVE-2026-105437.

### Security bug fixes

* [CVE-2026-111760](https://github.com/git/git/security/advisories/GHSA-vp2w-7xxj-jvxr):

  Recursive clones are susceptible to Remote Code Execution: an attacker-controlled repository can be crafted in a way that exploits a bug in Git whereby Git can be fooled into overwriting a gitfile (used for submodules) with a symbolic link that then points to a directory with malicious config or hooks. The config or hooks may have attacker-specified code.

* [CVE-2026-113408](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/809):

  It is possible for a server to advertise an unborn HEAD that contains path-traversal characters (e.g., `refs/heads/../../../TARGET`). With the files ref backend that can lead to ref-updating actions to write to unwanted files.

* [CVE-2026-114467](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/810):

  When Git strips the GPG signatures from a commit message, it only accounts for two signatures. A commit message containing more than two signatures therefore causes a stack memory corruption.

  This can be triggered when using `git merge` with a tag which contains more than two signatures. As such, this makes way for a DoS attack which can potentially also affect forges when such a tag is pushed to a remote and a merge action is initiated.

* [CVE-2026-114469](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/811):

  Git rejects patches larger than ~1 GiB, because its patch application code does not work well with large files. That check, however, only considered the size of the patch as it appears in the input, which for binary patches is much smaller than the size of the file the patch describes, as binary patches are compressed and encoded. A binary patch that inflates to a very large size therefore slipped past the check and crashed Git with an out-of-bounds read.

* [CVE-2026-105437](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/814):

  When merging, Git computes the size of the buffer holding the merge result in a way that can overflow for very large merges, which can be triggered by a large number of conflicts combined with a large `conflict-marker-size`. The resulting buffer can then be too small, and Git writes past its end (and, before and after that, before its start), corrupting the heap.

* [CVE-2026-114466](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/812):

  In response to CVE-2019-1348, `fast-import` disallows the `export-marks` feature by default. The features `rewrite-submodules-to` and `rewrite-submodules-from` as well as the option `export-pack-edges` that were introduced in the meantime also allow reading from arbitrary paths, and are therefore now also disallowed by default.

* Comes with [Git v2.56.1](https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.56.1/Documentation/RelNotes/2.56.1.adoc).

## Release notes

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

jan.changelog:
## Jan v0.8.8: security fixes, llama.cpp 0.7.0, and Trusted Hosts for the local API

A security update to v0.8.7. We recommend updating. Your data and settings carry over; a few behaviours change, listed under **What you might notice**.

### Security

- **Links in chat open in your browser.** Links in model replies, tool results, model cards and release notes now always open in your system browser, never inside Jan's window. Links that aren't web or email links are shown as plain text.
- **The local API server checks where browser requests come from.** A web page can only call it if its origin is trusted: the same machine, Jan itself, or a host you list in **Trusted Hosts**. Requests without a browser origin (SDKs, scripts, curl, Claude Code) work as before.
- **Server-side tool execution stays opt-in for every endpoint.** Requests to the local API run MCP tools only when **Settings > Local API Server** allows server-side tool execution.
- **Paths are checked before Jan reads or writes them.** Thread and assistant ids, and the file operations extensions use, stay inside Jan's data folder.
- **The Claude Code integration writes your shell profile safely.** Values are quoted, unusual variable names are refused, and Jan's lines are kept in one marked block that Reset removes completely without touching your own lines.
- **The agent's file tools no longer follow a link out of their workspace**, and folders such as your home, credentials and startup folders can't be attached as writable.
- **Windows: Jan runs system tools from the Windows system folder**, and sign-in links are opened without going through `cmd`.
- **MCP sign-in only uses web addresses** (`http`/`https`) for its endpoints.

### What you might notice

- **Trusted Hosts for browser-based clients.** A web app on another machine (for example Open WebUI's direct connection) or a browser extension calling Jan's API needs its host added to **Settings > Local API Server > Trusted Hosts**. Entries can include a scheme, so `app://obsidian.md` works for Obsidian plugins (thanks to [@SnowingFox](https://github.com/SnowingFox), [#8608](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/8608)). Pages without a normal origin (local files, sandboxed frames) can be allowed by listing `file://` or `null`.
- **The CORS switch now takes effect**, and it starts **on** after updating. In earlier versions it was shown but had no effect.
- **Custom environment variables for Claude Code:** keys that change how programs are found (`PATH`, `PATHEXT`, `SystemRoot`, `ComSpec`, `LD_*`, `DYLD_*`, `JAN_*` and the GPU runtime paths Jan uses) are refused with a message. Other variables, including `NODE_OPTIONS`, save as before.
- **Moving the data folder** to a system folder, your home folder itself or a drive root (for example `D:\`) is refused; choose a folder such as `D:\Jan`.
- **MCP servers whose sign-in endpoints aren't web addresses** now show a sign-in error.

### New

**llama.cpp engine 0.7.0.**

The bundled engine moves from 0.5.0 to 0.7.0 (b11669). New per-model settings: an **MoE expert GPU cache** for mixture-of-experts models, **Probabilistic draft sampling** and **Draft batch size** for speculative decoding. They default to the engine's own defaults, so nothing changes unless you set them. Saved prompt caches from the previous engine are discarded once and rebuilt. ([#9399](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9399))

### Fixes

**Local models failed to load on Windows when the user name had non-English characters** (for example Cyrillic). ([#9418](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9418))

**With an HTTP proxy configured, documents with "Use embeddings" failed**, because Jan's requests to its own engine went through the proxy. They now go direct; remote providers still use the proxy. ([#9353](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9353))

**An attachment was sent again on every turn**, adding a copy per message and defeating the prompt cache. It's now included once per request. Thanks to [@yaodong-shen](https://github.com/yaodong-shen). ([#9358](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9358))

**With Shell turned off, a model that called the shell ended its reply.** It now gets "Shell is turned off" and the reply continues. ([#9319](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/9319))

**macOS: quitting Jan left the MLX server running** with its model in memory. It's stopped on quit, and one left by an earlier Jan is stopped at startup; an MLX server you started yourself is left alone. ([#9355](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/9355))

### Thanks

Fixes in this release include work from [@greatjourney589](https://github.com/greatjourney589) ([#8068](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/8068)), [@SnowingFox](https://github.com/SnowingFox) ([#8627](https://github.com/janhq/jan/pull/8627)) and [@orenyomtov](https://github.com/orenyomtov).

### Known issues

- **Auto compact** needs **Max Context Tokens** set for remote models; Jan does not detect a remote model's context window yet ([#9317](https://github.com/janhq/jan/issues/9317)).
- Local models do not run on Intel Macs, as in v0.8.5.

Full notes: https://github.com/janhq/jan/blob/main/docs/src/pages/changelog/2026-10-28-jan-v0.8.8.mdx

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/janhq/jan/compare/v0.8.7...v0.8.8

greenshot.changelog:
Pre-release of Greenshot 1.3.328.

## What's Changed

### Security

- Fixed a security issue where Greenshot sent the user's Windows credentials to any server it requested content from, so a malicious image URL could trigger an automatic NTLM authentication exchange. Reported by [@Y4k150b4](https://github.com/Y4k150b4); fixed by [@Lakritzator](https://github.com/Lakritzator) (Robin Krom) and [@jklingen](https://github.com/jklingen) in [commit 5b7dca1](https://github.com/greenshot/greenshot/commit/5b7dca10d9b56dc5fef55189030879a1ddd29312). [GHSA-gjcr-pccx-w2vg](https://github.com/greenshot/greenshot/security/advisories/GHSA-gjcr-pccx-w2vg)

### Installer & Upgrades

- All executables and DLLs shipped with Greenshot, including plugins and third-party libraries, are now code-signed, so Windows Smart App Control no longer blocks unsigned files — by [@Lakritzator](https://github.com/Lakritzator) (Robin Krom) and [@jklingen](https://github.com/jklingen) in [PR #1505](https://github.com/greenshot/greenshot/pull/1505)

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash that could occur when Windows could not create a toast notifier — by [@Lakritzator](https://github.com/Lakritzator) (Robin Krom) in [PR #1515](https://github.com/greenshot/greenshot/pull/1515)

### Technical Details

- **Release scope**: This is the 11th stable release of the 1.3 series. Versions 1.3.324 to 1.3.327 were intermediate builds; their changes are rolled into this release.

czkawka.changelog:
## Version 12.0.2 - 09.09.2026r

### Czkawka GTK Deprecation Notice
**Version 12.0 is the last released version of Czkawka GTK.** No new binaries will be provided from this point on. All users are encouraged to migrate to Krokiet, the new Slint-based GUI frontend.

### Core
- Surfaced rollback rename failures in `make_hard_link`/`make_file_symlink` instead of silently ignoring them - [#1995](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/1995)
- Switched the XDG portal trash implementation to `async-io`, avoiding a Tokio runtime requirement alongside Slint's async-io backend - [#2025](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2025)
- Fixed the AVIF license metadata - [#2060](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2060)
- Fixed the AVIF tests - [#2061](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2061)

### CLI
- Rejected non-finite user input (e.g. `NaN`/`inf`) in numeric arguments - [#2038](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2038)

### Krokiet
- Fixed popup OK/Close button text truncation and centered popups more reasonably - [#2043](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2043)
- Added the ability to start a scan in Krokiet via CLI arguments - [#2069](https://github.com/qarmin/czkawka/pull/2069)

## Legend:
- If you are a beginner or don't know which version to use, start with one of these depending on your OS (if they don’t work, try different builds):
  - **Windows** – `windows_krokiet_on_windows_skia_opengl.exe`, `windows_krokiet_on_linux.exe`, `windows_czkawka_gui_gtk_412.zip`  
  - **Mac** – `mac_krokiet_skia_vulkan_x86_64`, `mac_krokiet_skia_vulkan_arm64`, `mac_czkawka_gui_x86_64`, `mac_czkawka_gui_arm64`
  - **Linux** – `linux_krokiet_x86_64`, `linux_krokiet_all_backends`, `linux_czkawka_gui_x86_64`
- `krokiet` – primary graphical version of the application, fully supported and actively developed, includes new features and ongoing improvements
- `gtk_gui` – legacy GTK-based graphical version
- `cedinia` - new android app
- `cli` – command-line version of the app
- `arm`, `x86_64` – CPU architecture. Most Windows/Linux uses `x86_64`, while on Mac the `arm` version is becoming the most common choice. 
- `heif`, `raw`, `avif` – additional features that require extra libraries installed on the OS
- `skia_opengl`, `skia_vulkan`, `femtovg_wgpu`, `all_backends` – alternative Krokiet backends, use different, when you have problem with current
- `deps` - scripts that you can run, to install required/optional apps/libraries

Other third-party library updates

xpipe.changelog:
## Changes

- Docker and Podman containers now show how long they have been running or how long ago they exited,
  along with their health status if a health check is configured. The uptime is now automatically adjusted,
  so it doesn't need an explicit refresh anymore.
- Docker compose services now also show their uptime and health status
- The available shells scan is no longer preselected in the scan dialog, and the SSH config scan is only preselected for the local machine
- The Claude Code MCP setup command in the settings now also shows how to add the server for all directories

## Fixes

- Fix Docker containers not showing the standard system information like other connections
- Fix the daemon connection failures when external API requests are enabled on macOS
- Fix special characters in file paths being mangled for pure SFTP connections
- Fix dragging a category onto itself or one of its subcategories causing errors
- Fix old <v24 categories without a saved order not being reorderable relative to each other (this might reorder categories from old vaults once)
- Fix categories with an empty name breaking the MCP tools
- Fix various NullPointers


## Downloads

You can find all downloadable artifacts below attached to this release. For installation instructions, see the [installation guide](https://docs.xpipe.io/guide/installation).

All artifacts are signed by [Christopher Schnick (BBDA 885A DD3E 0AD0)](https://xpipe.io/signatures/0xDD3E0AD0.asc)

ripgrep.changelog:
[Sponsorship is appreciated!](https://github.com/sponsors/BurntSushi/)

This release fixes a number of bugs related to gitignore matching as well as
some performance improvements in directory tree traversal.

> In case you haven't heard of it before, ripgrep is a line-oriented search
> tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern.
> By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and automatically skip
> hidden files/directories and binary files.

Platform support:

* `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl` is now included in the release binaries for
  ripgrep.

Performance improvements:

* [PERF #3293](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3293):
  Improves directory traversal time on very large corpora.

Feature enhancements:

* [FEATURE #3275](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/3275):
  ripgrep now respects `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` and `GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM`.

Bug fixes:

* [BUG #3212](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3212):
  Don't check for the existence of `.jj` when `--no-ignore` is used.
* [BUG #3320](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3419),
  [BUG #3376](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3376),
  [BUG #3419](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/pull/3419):
  Fix gitignore matching bug when searching across multiple directories.

fzf.changelog:
- Added `{change,transform,bg-transform}-info-command` actions (#4951) (@casperdcl)
  ```sh
  seq 100 | fzf --info-command 'echo "mode: A | $FZF_INFO"' \
                --bind 'ctrl-a:change-info-command:echo "mode: A | $FZF_INFO"' \
                --bind 'ctrl-b:change-info-command:echo "mode: B | $FZF_INFO"'
  ```
- `transform-nth` and `transform-with-nth` (and their `bg-` variants) no longer split the output at `|`
    - Only `change-nth` and `change-with-nth` rotate through `|`-separated values
    - Fixed the bound command being replaced with the output. e.g. With `transform-nth(echo '1|2')`, the next key press ran `2|1` as a shell command.
    - A `--with-nth` template in the output can now contain `|`. e.g. `{2}|{1}` was cut to `{2}`.
- `change-nth` and `transform-nth` now handle empty and invalid values the same way as `change-with-nth` and `transform-with-nth`
    - An empty value restores the default `--nth`. Previously, `change-nth()` and an empty `transform-nth` output searched all fields. Use `change-nth(..)` for that.
    - A non-empty invalid value is ignored. Previously, it restored the default `--nth`.
- `change-nth` and `change-with-nth` now apply the value after the current one in the `|`-separated list
    - A value equal to the current one is skipped, e.g. the first value when it is the initial `--nth`
    - Invalid values in the list are skipped
    - The rotation follows the current value even when another binding changed it, or when the action is printed by `transform` (unless the list contains the same value more than once)
    - You can list the values in their natural order, starting with the initial one
      ```sh
      # Previously, you would have to write:
      ls -al | fzf --with-nth .. --bind 'space:change-with-nth:1|2|..'

      # Now you can write:
      ls -al | fzf --with-nth .. --bind 'space:change-with-nth:..|1|2'
      ```
- Fixed `--no-sort` being ignored in filter mode with `--sync`, `--tac`, or `--bench` (#4940) (@NavpreetSSidhu)
- Fixed `--walker=follow` skipping a symlink in one `--walker-root` when its target is an ancestor of another root (#4944) (@mabunemeh)
- Fixed data races in the preview and the search result cache (#4947)
- Fixed O(n^2) action parsing in `--listen`. A single ~1 MB request could block the server for ~30 s (@zachariah-mithani, AploSec)
- Windows
    - Fixed `--with-shell` on Windows not detecting cmd, PowerShell, and pwsh, which made fzf quote commands and entries for a POSIX shell (#4936) (@vimkim)
        - e.g. With `--with-shell "cmd.exe /d /c"`, `--preview '"C:\Program Files\nu\bin\nu.exe" --version'` failed
    - Added `.msi` installers for amd64 and arm64, also offered through winget (#4943) (@meop)
        - The portable package runs fzf through a symlink in the WinGet Links folder, which an administrator's SSH session refuses to follow
        - The MSI installs `fzf.exe` under Program Files and adds it to the system PATH
        - `winget upgrade` keeps an existing portable install. To switch to the MSI, run `winget uninstall junegunn.fzf` and `winget install junegunn.fzf`.
- Vim plugin
    - Fixed garbage text on screen in Neovim with `set title` when the fzf command contains ANSI escape sequences (#4941)
- nushell
    - The completion integration now requires nushell 0.116.1 or above, where an interactive completer can take the terminal through the `@interactive` attribute (#4934) (@sim590)

micro.changelog:
Micro 2.0.15

Get well into 2026 and have a happy new year! :fireworks: 

## What's Changed
New options
- `truecolor` (supersedes the `MICRO_TRUECOLOR` environment variable) (by @JoeKar in #2867)
- `showchars` (deprecates `indentchar`) (by @Neko-Box-Coder in #3760)
- `lockbindings` for completely disallowing plugins to modify keybindings (by @Neko-Box-Coder in #3618)
- `helpsplit` for changing default split type for the `help` command (by @JoeKar in #3502)
- `pageoverlap` for setting number of lines kept during page up/page down (by @nimishjha in #3518)

New actions
- `FirstTab`, `LastTab`, `FirstSplit` and `LastSplit` (by @masmu in #3403)
  - Note: also changed the behavior of `NextTab`, `PreviousTab`, `NextSplit`, `PreviousSplit`
  - But adjusted the default keybindings so the default behavior remains unchanged
- `SkipMultiCursorBack` as a counterpart to `SkipMultiCursor` (by @masmu in #3404)
- `CursorToViewTop`, `CursorToViewCenter`, `CursorToViewBottom` (by @nimishjha in #3506)
- `Duplicate` for duplicating the selection only, not the whole line (by @dmaluka in #3335)

Improved actions
- Improve and unify `CopyLine`, `CutLine`, `DeleteLine`, `DuplicateLine` actions (by @dmaluka in #3335 and #3519)
  - Note: changed the behavior of those actions
  - But also adjusted the default keybindings so the default behavior remains unchanged
- Restore pre-2.0.14 behavior of `SpawnMultiCursor{Up,Down}` (by @dmaluka in #3503)
- Nano-like page up/page down functionality (by @nimishjha in #3518 and @dmaluka in #3555)

Lua improvements
- Plugins never write to `settings.json` or `bindings.json` anymore (by @Neko-Box-Coder in #3618)
- Add `onBufferOptionChanged` callback (by @JoeKar in #2962)
- Add `SpawnCursorAtLoc()` (by @Neko-Box-Coder in #3441)
- Expose bufpane's `DoubleClick` and `TripleClick` to plugins (by @cutelisp in #3720)
- Pass mouse info to `{on,pre}MouseXXX` callbacks (by @dmaluka in #3779)
- Support `goto` statement from Lua 5.2 (by @matthias314 in #3597)

Syntax highlighting improvements
- Haskell syntax: various improvements and fixes (by @Andriamanitra in #3373)
- Rust syntax:
  - Recognize byte strings and C strings (by @jmcorey in #3452)

notepad4.changelog:
> [!Note]
> [v25.07r5738](https://github.com/zufuliu/notepad4/releases/tag/v25.07r5738) and later no longer supports Windows XP, Windows Server 2003 (see issue #974) and Windows 8/8.1 on ARM32 (Windows RT) (see issue #1023), use [v25.06r5696](https://github.com/zufuliu/notepad4/releases/tag/v25.06r5696) instead.

## Changes Since [v26.08r6282](https://github.com/zufuliu/notepad4/releases/tag/v26.08r6282)
* Scintilla updated to 5.6.7, see https://www.scintilla.org/ScintillaHistory.html for the changes.
* Add menu "File -> Update File Time" to touch current file (update modification time without change attribute or content), issue #1310. d5a47e02e613afff63323d5cc577590d1089fc11
* Improved Russian translation, contributed by @Dimmitrius in PR #1308. 752defc886b53cd813b8a1c95bf21f49aa49ffbc
* Use short name for manually saved backup file, issue #1314. 26ca81ad6f844bcb6cbd785606f24cb919a2f5f6
* Lexer and API updates: HTML and PHP (91959ac6d1db696c0b45c6bc647cccb8081341a1, 4336a7824c608b019b2691a8b7170203e430880a, 3edbb3217d013ef5532fa2f615181bf3deb3baed, f72a811afd4d03b71c2801cd17491295d5d51f40, 2c69a0528837c90eef1a24bc3a76573afdcfcdda, a68c27d2f3c121a2bc799093c6b080fa10e32fad, etc.), Perl (1d06d41be25a9df959aa3897b90cd5e787f8755b), Python (046570920ce9067ef581473601dc20abe4fa5567), SQL (71c417502987ed17f323a7198571c05498d786ef, 537c435ba5c85604098657f8c9396c8b3b3bdd4d), WebAssembly (b5a5108259cdb9206b4fb2db01ccf4c438ab066c, 495b835a3c622146f12aac761c1ed2b2963b2cb7), XML (d851dbeaa52bb146cf28f1d07666fbd839c49474).
* Fix multiple "Inconsistent Line Endings" dialogs after file auto reloading, issue #1317. bc6c799223dadbaeabfc9f8125a6545cb162d64b
* Other bug fixes and improvements.

## Behavior Changes
* `/g line[,column]` (same as `-g line[,column]`) command line switch is changed to case sensitive (contributed by @lifenjoiner in PR #1305, 7522f0b8782aac168bc652b1701dbf04680fd898):
  * `/G line[,column[,tabwidth]]`: treat tab character as variable columns up to tab width (i.e. tab expansion), other character as single column. when `tabwidth` is zero or omitted use default document tab width.
  * `/g line[,column[,type]]`: no tab expansion, treat each character (when `type` is zero or omitted) or byte (when `type` is one) as single column. This matches Visual Studio and many others application where column is just character without tab expansion.
  * When `column` is negative: no tab expansion, treat each character as single column. negative column on "Goto" dialog is treated the same.
* Style configuration for JavaScript inside HTML is moved into standalone JavaScript scheme (same as PHP). dfa772f6d492157dec0247cda353ab4828cfff70

## File List
| Localization | Language | Architecture | Minimum System |
|--|--|--|--|
| de | Deutsch | ARM64 | 🟢Windows 10 on ARM |
| en | English | AVX512🧪 | 🟢64-bit Windows 10, Server 2019 |

1. [Platform Update for Windows 7](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=36805) is required for AVX2 version to use Direct2D on Windows 7 and Server 2008 R2.

Plugins can now open native windows and let you interact directly with search previews. Timer and Dictation are now standalone plugins you can install from the Wox Store as needed. We explain the move in [Keeping Wox Simple](https://www.woxlauncher.com/blog/a-smaller-core-with-plugins.html).

![Wox v2.5.0 Native UI for Plugins cover with an illustrated chart preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/refs/heads/master/screenshots/changelog-v2.5.0-woxview.png)

- Add
  - [`WoxView`] Fill out forms, change options, and explore live charts in plugins that use WoxView, either in a separate window or right from a search result.
  - [`Snippets`] Save and search text you use often. Copy a snippet from Wox or set it to expand when you type a keyword. Snippets can insert values such as today's date or the current clipboard text. [#4702](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/issues/4702)

- Improve
  - [`Timer` and `Dictation`] Install either plugin from the Wox Store when you need it. Wox carries over your existing plugin settings when you upgrade.
  - [`Screenshot`] Highlight parts of a screenshot and edit the strokes later. Choose a preset aspect ratio and keep it locked as you resize the capture area. [#4704](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/issues/4704)
  - [`AI Chat`] Connect to local models through LM Studio and see an indicator while waiting for a reply. [#4692](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/issues/4692)
  - [`Quick Jump`] Type to search in Directory Opus, with the search box appearing next to the active pane. [#4688](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/pull/4688) [@momadacoding](https://github.com/momadacoding)
  - [`Converter`] Convert Unix timestamps to your local date and time with `to datetime` or `to dt`. [#4685](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/issues/4685)
  - [`Hotkey`] Use Insert or Delete as a shortcut on its own, and trigger shortcuts by holding supported keys on Windows, macOS, and Hyprland.
  - [`Query`] Search within filter options and save default selections for each plugin command.
  - [`Plugin`] See installation and update progress in the toolbar, and take action directly from plugin notifications.
  - [`Plugin Store`] See download and star counts, and sort by downloads, stars, name, or recent updates.

- Fix
  - [`Clipboard`] Read the latest clipboard contents on Wayland and preserve text without appending a newline.
  - [`Notes`] Preserve blank lines when switching between Markdown and preview, and keep headings from being clipped.
  - [`Settings`] Keep the active field focused and preserve its selection when plugin settings refresh after saving.
  - [`Quick Jump`] Keep File Explorer context menu shortcuts working when type-to-search is enabled. [#4698](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/pull/4698) [@yiumanlenong](https://github.com/yiumanlenong)

UI follows the Wox language automatically. [#4694](https://github.com/Wox-launcher/Wox/pull/4694) [@designstudio](https://github.com/designstudio)

copytranslator.changelog:
### 主要更新（含使用方式）

#### 🚀 翻译能力增强

- 新增阿里云、Azure、DeepL、腾讯云、腾讯交互、Yandex、火山翻译引擎
- 新增彩云翻译与 Bing 词典引擎
- 支持 NVIDIA NIM 与 OpenRouter 自定义翻译器模板
- Google 翻译整合多后端（官方/Simply/Lingva），并优化 API 模式性能
- Lingva/Simply 增加响应校验与重试机制
- 更新谷歌翻译 API 镜像地址与超时时间

**如何使用：**
- 设置 → 翻译器管理：启用新增引擎或词典，必要时填写对应配置
- 设置 → API 设置：在“AI 翻译供应商/自定义翻译器”中添加 NVIDIA NIM、OpenRouter 模板并保存
- 引擎列表：选择新增引擎即可开始翻译

#### 🧩 翻译器管理与配置

- 翻译器管理界面重构为表格布局，交互更清晰
- 新增分组配置（缓存/对比/双击），支持拖拽排序
- 配置校验细化，显示可保存/可启用状态
- 配置字段支持元数据渲染与下拉选项
- 各翻译引擎增加配置指南链接
- 默认翻译器改为百度

**如何使用：**
